content.short: Cod3x is an AI trading terminal for deploying autonomous agents that trade perpetuals.
content.description: Cod3x lets users deploy AI agents that trade perpetuals on their behalf, sitting between a bot platform and a discretionary terminal. Handing execution to an agent removes emotional error and introduces a different one, since an agent will keep following a broken thesis with perfect discipline.
content.meta: Deploy autonomous agents that trade perpetuals on your behalf from a single terminal.
